caption: The editor of the app, Create your page, with Page settings, Editing Demo Mug and Theme colors on the left, and the generated product page on the right: five stars with the text 10,000+, the title Demo Mug, the price $9.50, four labels (Replacement Need, New Job, Quick Buy, Simplify Life), Quantity with Subtotal $9.50 and the text 25 in stock, a button Add to cart, the line Sarah and 438 people purchased, five payment icons, the lines Safe Payment and Free Shipping, and the start of a sample review card (Sarah K., Los Angeles, five stars, This is a sample review, please); the buttons at the top are Save as draft and Upgrade to publish. The 10,000+ and the 438 people were not taken from the store: the store had no such numbers. The small store icon in the bottom left corner of the Shopify menu is hidden; the person on the review card is a cartoon avatar of the sample review, not a real person.

The Subscription page of the app inside the Shopify admin: a field Enter discount code with Apply, the card Atlas base plan, $39 per month, All features included, only pay more as your business grows, a button Start 7-day free trial, the features License to use Atlas pages, AI store builder, AI product page builder, Bundler upsells & quantity breaks and Cart upsells, the usage included (Published product and landing pages up to 10, Bundle revenue up to $1,000, Cart orders up to 250) and the line If you exceed your plan usage, you are charged based on this usage rates. with a link usage rates; the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden, and so is the round photo and the name of the person in the chat message at the bottom right (a chat greeting of the vendor); the chat button itself is a generic icon.

The dialog Usage rates over the Subscription page, tab Published pages (next to the tabs Bundler and Cart drawer): Base up to 10 pages included; tier 1 up to 15 pages +$10/mo; tier 2 up to 25 +$20/mo; tier 3 up to 50 +$30/mo; tier 4 up to 75 +$40/mo; tier 5 up to 100 +$50/mo; tier 6 unlimited +$70/mo; behind the dialog the button Start 7-day free trial shows a spinner; the store name with its small icon in the bottom left corner of the menu is hidden, and so is the round photo and the name of the person in the chat message at the bottom right.
